entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Gade gwo chay manman sa... Li pa bèl je? Mwen te di ou mete tèt ansanm ak BARGHEST ta peye." t="Look at this motherlode… Ain't it a pretty sight? I told you teaming up with BARGHEST would pay off." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Pff, si ou di sa... Merde, choom, mwen pa t 'enskri pou okenn travayè depo…" t="Pff, if you say so… Shit, choom, I didn't sign up to be no warehouse worker..." b="" a=""/>
